name: Comfort
overview: Scripture reveals that true comfort comes from the presence and protection of the Lord, who strengthens the hearts of those who hope in Him and draws near to the brokenhearted. Even in the darkest moments, such as walking through the valley of the shadow of death, God's rod and staff provide reassurance and peace. His Word brings life and encouragement amid affliction, and dwelling in His presence offers a refuge under His mighty shadow. This divine comfort extends especially to those facing the end of life, affirming God's nearness and salvation to the contrite in spirit.
